propositions: reads through `ensure_fresh` (show, list, search, ready) can return empty or unparseable stdout under writer-lock contention when reconverge-lock timeout is insufficient

a generalized property test must verify that every zero-exit read invocation produces valid JSON output matching the surface's documented shape (dict for show, list/array for list/search/ready), distinguishing truncated-empty from legitimately-empty serialization
the throttle marker must be cleared before each parameterized read so all invocations exercise the reconverge path rather than short-circuiting to the local snapshot
the test harness reuses the ed2b write-burst + background-push contention model (repo_with_origin_tickets, _rebar_cli, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always) across all read surfaces
reverting _RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT from 2s back to 15s must cause the property to fail, confirming the fix is necessary for read-output integrity under contention
nonzero exits are acceptable (loud failure); the bug manifests as silent empty-success (exit 0 with truncated stdout)
